title: [AAPS3.0.0.1] Wear dont show forecast, although is it enabled in wear-settings
symptom: After installing AAPS 3.0.0.1 from master-branch, the Wear OS watch (Fossil Gen5) does not show the forecast line in watch faces with graph/diagram, even though forecast is enabled in wear settings. The regular and forecast lines are shown on the phone, but the watch only shows regular without forecast.
evidence_quote: the problem, that my watch (Fossil Gen5) don't show forecast-line in all watch faces with graph/diagram.
